heading_en: Method of Calculation under the Scenario Method
summary_ja: シナリオ法による算出方法を、想定上の原資産価格とボラティリティの設定、市場価値の算出、最大下回り額の採用、合計の順に定める。
summary_en: Prescribes the scenario method calculation: set assumed underlying prices and volatilities, revalue the options, take the largest shortfall by underlying asset, and sum.
paragraphs: The market risk equivalent amount for option transactions, etc. where the scenario method is used shall be the amount calculated as prescribed below: (i) For each group of option transactions, etc. with the same underlying asset, the assumed underlying asset price and the assumed volatility shall be set as prescribed below: (a) For the assumed underlying asset price, seven or more values shall be set at equal intervals within the range prescribed in (1) through (4) below according to the category of underlying asset set forth therein, from the level as of the calculation reference date. In this case, the values set shall include both ends of the range and the level as of the calculation reference date: (1) Debt instruments, etc. and interest rates: the assumed interest rate change corresponding to the time bands set forth in the table in Article 272-5, item (ii)(a) (the time bands for interest rates may be grouped into six or more time band groups (meaning groupings of time bands; the same applies hereinafter), but four or more time bands shall not be grouped into one time band group. In this case, for the assumed interest rate change, the largest of the assumed interest rate changes prescribed in that table corresponding to the time bands grouped into each time band group shall be used); (2) Equities, etc.: 8% up and down from the level as of the calculation reference date; (3) Foreign exchange and gold: 8% up and down from the level as of the calculation reference date; (4) Commodities, etc.: 15% up and down from the level as of the calculation reference date; (b) For the assumed volatility, three or more values shall be set within a range of 25% up and down from the level as of the calculation reference date. In this case, the values set shall include both ends of the range and the level as of the calculation reference date; (ii) For all combinations of the assumed underlying asset price and the assumed volatility set under the preceding item, the market value of the assumed option transactions, etc. in each case shall be calculated; (iii) The amount by which the market value of the assumed option transactions, etc. calculated under the preceding item falls below the market value of the option transactions, etc. as of the calculation reference date, in the case where that shortfall is the largest, shall be the market risk equivalent amount for each group of option transactions, etc. with the same underlying asset; (iv) The market risk equivalent amount relating to option transactions, etc. where the scenario method is used shall be the total of the market risk equivalent amounts for each group of option transactions, etc. with the same underlying asset calculated under the preceding item.
